schema_semantics.AdmissionReceipt: ACCEPTED is not configured/ready; expiry owner-issued not client supplied. Effect set bounded by actual owner authority.
schema_semantics.FrozenPlan: Each artifact entry has normalized exact path, before ABSENT or digest, after digest, ownership, byte size and mapping. Protected existing edits use owning protected route. New resource birth explicit guarded ABSENT semantics.
schema_semantics.DecisionReceipt: Role/kind bound to same frozen subject; actor derived by authenticated owner. Distinct decision kinds not collapsed.
schema_semantics.SourceRevision: UNBORN/ABSENT uses empty revision with explicit kind, not fake SHA; uncommitted snapshot cannot silently become a commit.
schema_semantics.OwnerSnapshot: Each phase card owner/phase/state/evidenceRef; progress fraction only known comparable units, no fake global percentage. Project ref includes verified/provisional kind; optional actual Mission/Action references only if they exist.
